concepts.definition: A coordinated defensive action in which one or more defenders apply observable pressure to an opponent in possession, with the evidence sufficient to describe the exposure and the opponent's response.
concepts.nonDefinition: A back-pass, a pressure event label, a tackle count, or a later regain alone is not proof that a press occurred.
minimumEvidence: timestamped spatial samples adequate for the claimed geometry
insufficientEvidence: sparse frames used to infer movement or closing speed
missing presser, carrier or relevant event
unresolved coordinate units or attacking direction
concepts.thresholdStatus: unapproved; no universal distance or time threshold is defined

concepts.definition: A pressing pattern in which observable defender positioning or movement limits credible opponent outlets toward a governed channel and the opponent responds within a reviewed window.
concepts.nonDefinition: A press followed by a turnover or a failed pass does not by itself prove that the opponent was channelled or trapped.
minimumEvidence: synchronized positions for relevant defenders, carrier and outlets
declared pitch transform and attacking direction
insufficientEvidence: one defender-carrier distance without outlet geometry
prohibitedClaims: forced response without evidence linking the pressure and action
concepts.thresholdStatus: unapproved; channel, coverage and time thresholds require football review

concepts.definition: A timestamped, observed opponent action during or after a declared pressure exposure, reported as sequence evidence without asserting that pressure caused it.
concepts.nonDefinition: A temporally subsequent pass, clearance or turnover is not automatically a reaction to pressure.
minimumEvidence: opponent action event with original ID and sequence
insufficientEvidence: event after the selected replay time
prohibitedClaims: causal wording such as forced unless separately reviewed

concepts.definition: A source-observed shot or governed attacking event that may be summarized by its recorded outcome; any derived threat score requires a separately validated metric definition.
concepts.nonDefinition: Possession share, raw shot count, a goal, or an uncalibrated player metric is not a probability of scoring or a general danger rating.
minimumEvidence: canonical event ID and source label
metric version and calibration evidence if a numeric score is shown
insufficientEvidence: goal metadata without reconciled canonical goal event
prohibitedClaims: xG or scoring probability without a rights-cleared calibrated model
tactical superiority from possession or shot volume alone
concepts.thresholdStatus: unapproved; no numeric danger threshold or score is defined

concepts.definition: A time-bounded local numerical advantage for one team in an explicitly defined pitch region and phase, measured from eligible synchronized player locations.
concepts.nonDefinition: Formation labels, nominal roles, or a static count of listed players do not establish a local overload.
minimumEvidence: all relevant active players at selected time
coordinate units, pitch dimensions and direction
prohibitedClaims: quantitative overload from sparse or incomplete frames
advantage without declaring which players and region count
concepts.thresholdStatus: unapproved; region, time and count thresholds are unset

concepts.definition: A completed action that moves the ball beyond an explicitly observed opponent defensive line, where the relevant line geometry is available before and after the action.
concepts.nonDefinition: A provider label such as LineBreakingPass or forward ball movement alone does not prove that an actual defensive line was broken.
minimumEvidence: synchronized opponent positions sufficient to identify the line
ball or receiver location before and after
prohibitedClaims: line break inferred from provider taxonomy alone
formation treated as observed defensive-line geometry
concepts.thresholdStatus: unapproved; line-identification and coverage thresholds are unset

concepts.definition: An immediate, observable attempt by the team that has just lost possession to regain it, evaluated within a football-reviewed time window and with possession continuity evidence.
concepts.nonDefinition: A pressure event near a turnover, or a later regain by either team, is not sufficient by itself.
minimumEvidence: team identities before and after loss
prohibitedClaims: team intention inferred from temporal proximity alone

concepts.definition: The observable positioning and coverage of a team's players behind or around its attacking action, assessed for the declared opponent transition risk and selected phase.
concepts.nonDefinition: Nominal formation, player roles, or a static snapshot alone does not establish effective rest defence.
minimumEvidence: synchronized positions for relevant players and opponents
declared pitch transform and active roster
insufficientEvidence: sparse samples used to infer movement
prohibitedClaims: effective protection or tactical intent without reviewed criteria
player velocity reconstructed from sparse frames
concepts.thresholdStatus: unapproved; protection criteria and thresholds are unset
